description: Every arbitrary probability and parameter of the randomizer. Each entry is {"value": ..., "description": ...}; edit the value, keep the description up to date. Loaded and checked by mh4u_rando/data/tuning.py; documented in docs/data.md.

rare_map_weight.description: Relative weight of a map category set to 'occasional' (arenas, Everwood); a normal map weighs 1.

quest_monster_material_share.description: Rewards 'quest monsters and rank': share of the materials of a reward box taken from the quest's own monsters (the rest from the whole rank).

balanced_tier_range.description: Progression 'balanced': a monster may be replaced by one up to this many tiers easier or harder.

random_structure_max_waves.description: Structure 'random': maximum number of waves of a quest.

health_ratio_per_tier.description: Adjust health: health index multiplied by this for every tier the new monster is above the replaced one (divided when below). Provisional formula.

attack_ratio_per_tier.description: Adjust attack: like health_ratio_per_tier, for the attack index.

progressive_sigma.description: Stat mode 'progressive': standard deviation of the bell curve of the change (0.08 = most changes within ±8 %).

progressive_max_change.description: Stat mode 'progressive': the change is clipped to ±this share of the original value.

skill_negative_points_probability.description: Armor skills: probability that a piece gets one negative skill with these points (at most one per piece; the rest of the time none). Its points are added to the positive skills.

skill_points_decay.description: Armor skills, chaotic: each extra point of a positive skill is this many times as likely as one point less (0.6: +1 is the most common, +5 about 13 times rarer).

skill_count_weights.description: Armor skills: relative weight of each number of skills of a piece, e.g. {"1": 1, "2": 2, "3": 3}; null = every number from 1 to the user's maximum equally likely.

skill_excluded_trees.description: Armor skills: skill trees never given by the randomizer (English names).
